input.name: Ledger
input.where:
file: ledger.py, lines 20-26
def pad_flag(flag: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Pad to a whole number of blocks.

    >>> len(pad_flag(b"flag{cbc_m4c_f0rg3ry_1s_e4sy}"))
    32
    """
    n = 16 - len(flag) % 16
    return flag + bytes([n]) * n
input.description: Every transaction in the ledger is authenticated. ledger.py runs at nc ledger.chal.example.test 7777, with the real flag.
